verdicts.reason: Both lose the original's warm orange wash and leave an arbitrary orange vertical strip. Both also separate the line frame from the text, so it is an empty box, and they reorder the copy so the tickets line sits above 'Theatre presents'. In A the empty frame floats mid-left and the play icon collides with its corner, but the text block sits mostly on dark image and stays readable. B is worse: the text block straddles the edge of the orange strip and the busy photo, the small copy is cramped with tight letterspacing, and the empty frame is jammed against the left canvas edge with the play icon overlapping it.
